name: Eyecandies: Synthetic Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection Dataset
description: Synthetic multimodal industrial inspection benchmark comprising 15,500 object samples (yielding 93,000 rendered images) across 10 candy classes moving on an industrial conveyor scenario. Procedurally rendered with BlenderProc, each sample provides registered multimodal captures including six distinct spotlight illumination conditions, metric depth maps, surface normal maps, and pixel-precise ground truth defect masks.

provenance.curation_notes: Each of the 10 classes contains 1,000 train, 100 validation, 50 public test, and 400 private test samples. Ground truth masks precisely segment surface deformations and missing elements.
